An AI draft should be easy to check.

Keep the source beside the answer. Ask which line supports each statement. If the source is silent, the draft should say so.

Copy this complete prompt to get the same results.

Review this draft against the supplied source. Return a table with each factual statement, the exact supporting source phrase, and a status of supported, contradicted or not found. Do not add facts or resolve missing information by guessing. Source: [paste redacted source]. Draft: [paste draft].

Check the table yourself before using it. Use only an approved tool and authorized, redacted data.

## What is Lexis+ with Protégé legal AI software?

Lexis+ with Protégé\* is a legal AI solution for research, analysis, and drafting. It combines the power of the generative Protégé™ AI assistant with trusted LexisNexis content and built-in verification, so legal professionals can do their work from a single prompt box.  
  
*\*Formerly Lexis+ AI*

## Core Legal AI Features & Sources

Core Features & Legal SourcesWhat powers Lexis+ with Protégé

Integrate advanced AI with authoritative, exclusive LexisNexis sources and your organization’s documents in one workspace.

### Protégé

LexisNexis Protégé is the AI assistant embedded across LexisNexis solutions — powering research, drafting, and analysis workflows.

Explore Protégé

### Primary law and exclusive secondary sources

Access one of the world's most comprehensive repositories of authoritative case law, statutes, regulations, and exclusive secondary sources.

### Practical Guidance

Leverage expert-authored practice notes, annotated forms, and drafting guidance across 25 practice areas.

### *Shepard’s* citations

Validate citations and confirm the status and treatment of authorities directly within your research and drafting workflow.

### Web and news sources

Incorporate real-time news and web content when timely context is required.

### Your organization’s documents

Connect to iManage, SharePoint, NetDocuments, and other DMS platforms to ask and draft from your organization’s knowledge.

Explore integration

### Secure document Vault

Securely store and analyze large document sets. Preserve context across sessions for drafting, review, and analysis.
